title: Moroccan Harira Stew
description: A traditional Moroccan stew made with harira, foie gras, and spices. This rich and flavorful dish is perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the harira and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the foie gras and cook for 1-2 minutes, until heated through.
Add the Moroccan spices and stir to combine.
Serve hot, garnished with additional spices if desired.
Note: Foie gras should be cooked to an internal temperature of 130°F (54°C) to ensure food safety.
